name: Loader
summary: The full-surface branded loading screen shown while a new environment boots — the animated AhaSlides splash, centred on white.
highlights: Animated AhaSlides splash logo, centred at a fixed size
Shown while a new environment boots; await cycleDone so the splash always plays in full once
logo-only shows the finished logo alone, no dot ring, for short and inline loads
variant="tiles" keeps the previous five-tile look for a flagged rollout
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-loader> — the branded loading SCREEN for an environment transition (landing in the editor, opening the presenting view). It fills its container on a white ground and centres the animated AhaSlides splash at a fixed size: a ring of eight brand dots gathers into the centre, the four logo petals bloom out of it with a quarter-turn, hold, then close one by one and throw the dots back out (a 3.65s loop that opens on the finished logo). The petals are the DS splash logo (logo/thesplash.svg) verbatim, filled from the --aha-vivid-pink-100 and --aha-logo-purple tokens; the logo is --aha-loader-size wide (default 112px) whatever the container, so it fits a small inline box as well as a full screen. One requestAnimationFrame loop per element, started on connect and cancelled on disconnect; under prefers-reduced-motion it shows the finished logo, still. logo-only drops the dot ring and the bloom: the very first frame is the finished logo, which holds, turns once with a gentle shrink and settles upright again (a 2.2s loop); its drawing box is exactly --aha-loader-size with no min-height, so it reads at 16–48px in a short or inline load that ends before a bloom would. variant="tiles" keeps the previous look (five <aha-illustration> loader-* tiles cycling with a staggered soft-flow); with no attribute, <html data-aha-loader="tiles"> picks the tiles for every loader on the page, so an app can switch all of them at one entry point behind a flag (the attribute wins). Show it until the app is ready: a loader swapped out mid-bloom reads as a glitch, so wait for `await loader.cycleDone` (resolves after one full cycle since connect, at once under reduced motion, tiles and logo-only) as well as for the data; AhaLoader.CYCLE_MS is the cycle length and an `aha-loader-cycle` event fires at each completed cycle. engine="layers" is an opt-in way to play the same splash: each petal and dot is its own layer moved only by CSS transform and opacity keyframes sampled from the same timeline, so the browser keeps it moving while the page's main thread is busy booting an app; it cannot blur the petals together as they open, so it fades into the finished logo instead. This is the full-screen SCREEN — for an inline indeterminate spinner reach for <aha-spin>.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) and Vue both render <aha-loader> directly via attributes. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design; the splash petals are the DS logo's own paths and the tiles variant reuses the DS's <aha-illustration> spot art (registry family `loader`), never redrawn here. To switch every loader in an app back to the tiles at one entry point, set document.documentElement.dataset.ahaLoader = 'tiles' before the loaders connect.

spec.label: Ground
spec.value: white full-surface (--aha-white); fills its container, min-height 240px

spec.label: Logo
spec.value: the DS splash (logo/thesplash.svg paths), --aha-loader-size wide (default 112px), centred; the drawing box is 1.5 × that size so the dot ring and bloom fit

spec.label: Colour
spec.value: petals and dots in --aha-vivid-pink-100 and --aha-logo-purple only

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: 8 dots gather (0.43s) → petals bloom with a -70° to 0° turn → hold → petals close one by one, each sweeping 35° → dots fly back out and turn once; 3.65s loop, opens on the finished logo

spec.label: Loop lifecycle
spec.value: one requestAnimationFrame loop per element, started in connectedCallback, cancelled in disconnectedCallback; browsers suspend it in a hidden tab

spec.label: Logo only
spec.value: logo-only: the four petals only, never the dot ring; opens on the finished logo, holds 0.8s, then turns 360° over 1.4s (ease-in-out) shrinking to 78% at the midpoint so the tips stay in the box; 2.2s loop; drawing box = --aha-loader-size square, host min-height 0; ignored by the tiles variant

spec.label: Full cycle
spec.value: AhaLoader.CYCLE_MS = 3652 (one loop at 1.15x); element.cycleDone resolves once one full cycle has played since connect (at once under prefers-reduced-motion, variant="tiles" and logo-only); aha-loader-cycle fires at each completed cycle with detail.count, bubbling and composed

spec.label: Layers engine
spec.value: engine="layers" (opt-in, full splash only): 4 petal layers, 1 finished-logo layer and 8 dot layers, each with its own @keyframes on transform or opacity only (180 samples of the same timeline per 3652ms cycle, linear between them), so the compositor plays them while the main thread is blocked; no SVG attribute animation and no filter, so the petals do not melt together while they open: the finished logo fades in over the last of the bloom instead; CYCLE_MS, cycleDone, aha-loader-cycle and reduced motion behave as on the default engine; ignored by logo-only and tiles

spec.label: Reduced motion
spec.value: prefers-reduced-motion renders the finished logo once, no loop

spec.label: Tiles variant
spec.value: variant="tiles" (or <html data-aha-loader="tiles">, read on connect): five 120×120 radius-xl tiles of reused <aha-illustration> loader-* art, soft-flow keyframe, 7.5s loop (--aha-loader-duration), easing --aha-ease-in-out

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name announced by the role=status live region (e.g. "Opening the editor…")

props.name: variant
props.desc: splash = the animated AhaSlides logo; tiles = the previous five-tile look. Unset, it follows <html data-aha-loader> ("tiles" or unset), read when the loader connects

props.name: logo-only
props.desc: Show the finished AhaSlides logo alone, with no dot ring or bloom, for short and inline loads (16–48px via --aha-loader-size). Only the logo animates: hold, one calm turn, settle. The tiles variant ignores it

props.name: engine
props.desc: How the full splash is played. svg (default) redraws one drawing every frame from the page; layers moves each petal and dot as its own layer with CSS keyframes, so the motion keeps playing while the app's startup code keeps the page busy. Ignored by logo-only and the tiles variant

whenToUse.when: a full-screen environment transition — the user lands in a new surface (workspace → editor, editor → presenting) and waits for it to boot
an inline, indeterminate wait inside an existing surface — a button, a panel, a section loading in place
the layout of the content being loaded is known — show its shape rather than a spinner

opinion.note: One Loader per transition, filling the whole surface. It is decorative brand motion, not a progress bar — don't pair it with a percentage. Keep the `label` a short present-tense phrase naming the destination ("Opening the editor…"). Size it with --aha-loader-size, never by scaling the element. Do not swap the loader out before `await loader.cycleDone`, so the splash always plays through once.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the default look is the animated AhaSlides splash (design: Trang, logo animation option 1 v5, final pick: bloom, flower close, gathering ring of 8 dots, no circle). The previous look, ported from the product Loader (stpancras-storybook UI/AhaLoader: five icon-cards, 7.5s soft-flow, 1.5s stagger), stays as variant="tiles". a11y: host role=status + aria-live=polite + aria-label from `label`; reduced motion shows the still logo.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

fixed logo size via --aha-loader-size, centred; fits a 240px-high box
rAF loop starts on connect, cancelled on disconnect
host role=status + aria-live, aria-label from label

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Probes the default splash: white ground, the drawing box at 1.5 × the default 112px logo size, four petals and eight dots, and the two petal fills resolving to the brand tokens. Per-frame transforms are NOT measured — size, colour and counts are stable across the loop.

events.name: aha-loader-cycle
events.desc: Fired each time the splash completes a full cycle since it connected (count 1, 2, …); never fires under prefers-reduced-motion, for tiles or for logo-only
